caption: The drawing features three distinct square sections, each displaying a different fabric or textile pattern, vertically aligned on a plain off-white background. The top square displays a pattern of white leaves with visible veins and clusters of small white dots, all set against a dark brown or black ground. The middle square shows a border design: the upper and lower edges are adorned with a wavy red line and small red loops, while the central portion consists of a repeating pattern of evenly spaced red dots and small decorative motifs on a black background. The bottom square contains a pale reddish-brown or terracotta background, overlaid with a regular grid of small, dark circular shapes each with white centers resembling stylized flowers or dots; this section also has a handwritten note to the right reading “Place this over under slid.” The overall composition is orderly and symmetrical, with ample space between each square.
title: Patchwork from Spread (Quilt)
